'''Marc Vales González''' (born 4 April 1990) is an Andorran professional [[association football|footballer]] who plays for [[Gibraltar Football League]] club [[Europa F.C.|Europa FC]]. Mainly a [[Defender (association football)#Centre-back|central defender]], he can also play as a [[Midfielder#Defensive midfielder|defensive midfielder]].

==Club career==
Born in [[Les Escaldes]], [[Escaldes-Engordany]], Vales never competed in higher than [[Segunda División B]] during his lengthy spell in Spain, having started playing football with local [[UE Sant Julià|Sant Julià]]. Subsequently, he represented [[FC Andorra]] (two spells), [[CE Sabadell FC B|Sabadell B]], [[SE Eivissa-Ibiza B|Eivissa-Ibiza B]],<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.diariodeibiza.es/deportes/2008/09/09/eivissa-b-ficha-marc-vales-internacional-andorra/271570.html|title=El Eivissa B ficha a Marc Vales, internacional con Andorra|trans-title=Eivissa B sign Marc Vales, Andorran international|newspaper=Diario de Ibiza|first=Paco|last=Murillo|language=es|date=9 September 2008|access-date=15 February 2016}}</ref> [[CD Binéfar|Binéfar]] and [[Atlético Monzón]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vavel.com/es/futbol/2015/01/20/real-zaragoza/439432.html|title=Los 20 chuts de Marc Vales|trans-title=Marc Vales' 20 kicks|publisher=Vavel|first1=Patricia|last1=Lambán|first2=Natalia|last2=Hungría|language=es|date=20 January 2015|access-date=30 March 2021}}</ref>

In the summer of 2011, Vales signed for [[CD Atlético Baleares|Atlético Baleares]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.elperiodic.ad/noticia/15907/vales-sen-va-a-latletico-balearies-i-garcia-al-montso|title=Vales se'n va a l'Atlético Balearies i Garcia al Montsó|trans-title=Vales goes to Atlético Baleares and Garcia to Montsó|newspaper=[[El Periòdic d'Andorra]]|language=ca|date=22 July 2011|access-date=2 February 2022}}</ref> His first match in the [[Spanish football league system|third tier]] took place on 30 October, and he scored the game's only goal at home against [[CD Olímpic de Xàtiva|Olímpic de Xàtiva]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.marca.com/2011/10/30/futbol/mas_futbol/1320009485.html|title=Los gallitos aprenden a sufrir|trans-title=Top roosters learn how to suffer|newspaper=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]]|first=Pablo M.|last=Otero|language=es|date=30 October 2011|access-date=3 June 2016}}</ref>

Vales spent the vast majority of the following years in the same league – with the exception of a few months in the [[Tercera División]] with FC Andorra – with [[Real Madrid C]] (who acquired him on a [[Free transfer (association football)|free transfer]]),<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.faf.ad/pnfg/NNws_ShwNewDup?codigo=1004394&cod_primaria=3000302&cod_secundaria=3000674#.VsHSg_krLIU|title=Marc Vales fitxa pel Real Madrid CF C amb opcions a jugar al Castilla|trans-title=Marc Vales signs for Real Madrid CF C with options to play with Castilla|publisher=[[Andorran Football Federation]]|language=ca|date=17 July 2012|access-date=15 February 2016}}</ref> [[Deportivo Aragón|Zaragoza B]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.lasegundab.es/blog/2014/07/24/el-defensa-marc-vales-llega-a-zaragoza-30103.html|title=El defensa Marc Vales llega a Zaragoza|trans-title=Defender Marc Vales arrives at Zaragoza|publisher=La Segunda B|first=David|last=Barrera|language=es|date=24 July 2014|access-date=15 February 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vavel.com/es/futbol/2015/01/22/real-zaragoza/440244.html|title=Entrevista. Marc Vales: "El Real Zaragoza B está capacitado para lograr la permanencia"|trans-title=Interview. Marc Vales: "Real Zaragoza B have what it takes to stay up"|publisher=Vavel|first1=Patricia|last1=Lambán|first2=Natalia|last2=Hungría|language=es|date=22 January 2015|access-date=19 July 2020}}</ref> and [[CE L'Hospitalet|Hospitalet]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.vavel.com/es/futbol/real-zaragoza/509458-marc-vales-sale-del-real-zaragoza-y-ficha-por-el-hospitalet.html|title=Marc Vales sale del Real Zaragoza y ficha por el Hospitalet|trans-title=Marc Vales leaves Real Zaragoza and signs for Hospitalet|publisher=Vavel|first=Patricia|last=Lambán|language=es|date=3 July 2015|access-date=3 June 2016}}</ref> On 5 August 2016, he signed with Finnish side [[Seinäjoen Jalkapallokerho|SJK]] until the end of [[2016 SJK season|the season]], with the option of an additional campaign.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sjk2007.fi/uutiset/SJK_vahvistuu_Andorran_maajoukkuepelaajalla_8751.html|title=SJK vahvistuu Andorran maajoukkuepelaajalla|trans-title=SJK strengthen with Andorran national team player|publisher=SJK|language=fi|date=5 August 2016|access-date=5 August 2016|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160908171323/http://www.sjk2007.fi/uutiset/SJK_vahvistuu_Andorran_maajoukkuepelaajalla_8751.html|archive-date=8 September 2016}}</ref>

On 9 November 2016, SJK announced that they had agreed a new two-year contract with Vales.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://sjk2007.fi/uutiset/Marc_Vales_jatkaa_Seinajoella_8834.html|title=Marc Vales jatkaa Seinäjoella|trans-title=Marc Vales will continue with Seinäjoen|publisher=SJK|language=fi|date=9 November 2016|access-date=11 November 2016}}</ref> On 25 July 2018, he moved to the Norwegian [[Eliteserien]] with [[Sandefjord Fotball|Sandefjord]] on a two-and-a-half-year deal.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sandefjordfotball.no/nyheter/to-nye-spillere-klare-til-a-bidra|title=To nye spillere klare til â bidra|trans-title=Two new players ready to get going|publisher=Sandefjord Fotball|language=no|date=25 July 2018|access-date=25 July 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marcadorint.com/uefa-nations-league/marc-vales-andorra-entrevista-llegamos-mejor-momento-nuestra-historia/|title=Marc Vales: "Llegamos a la Nations League en el mejor momento de nuestra historia"|trans-title=Marc Vales: "We reach the Nations League in the best time of our history"|publisher=Marcadorint|first=Tomàs|last=Martínez|language=es|date=6 September 2018|access-date=19 July 2020}}</ref>

In January 2022, Vales signed for Malaysian club [[Kedah Darul Aman F.C.|Kedah Darul Aman]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.ara.ad/societat/marc-vales-ja-llueix-colors-kda-football-club_1_4256669.html|title=Marc Vales ja llueix els colors del KDA Football Club|trans-title=Marc Vales already doning colours of KDA Football Club|newspaper=[[Ara (newspaper)|Ara]]|first=Eduard|last=Piera|language=ca|date=31 January 2022|access-date=2 February 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.thestar.com.my/sport/football/2022/01/31/kedah-can-count-on-wise-ariff-to-take-over-leadership|title=Kedah can count on wise Ariff to take over leadership|newspaper=[[The Star (Malaysia)|The Star]]|date=31 January 2022|access-date=2 February 2022}}</ref> He returned to Spain on 13 February 2023, with the 32-year-old joining [[Real Unión]] in the [[Primera Federación]];<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sportberri.com/index.php/2023/02/13/el-central-marc-vales-se-incorpora-al-real-union/|title=El central Marc Vales se incorpora al Real Unión|trans-title=Stopper Marc Vales added to Real Unión|publisher=Sport Berri|first=Iñaki|last=De Mujika|language=es|date=13 February 2023|access-date=23 March 2023}}</ref> he changed teams again in the summer, on a contract at [[Segunda Federación]]'s [[CE Europa]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/esports/2023/08/03/marc_vales_fitxa_pel_europa_segona_rfef_225647_1128.html|title=Marc Vales fitxa pel CE Europa de Segona RFEF|trans-title=Marc Vales signs for CE Europa of ''Segunda RFEF''|newspaper=[[Diari d'Andorra]]|language=ca|date=3 August 2023|access-date=14 September 2023}}</ref>

Vales moved to the [[Tercera División]] with [[CE Atlètic Lleida|Atlètic Lleida]] on 20 August 2024.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.bondia.ad/esports/gabri-garcia-fitxa-marc-vales-per-a-l-atletic-lleida|title=Gabri García fitxa Marc Vales per a l’Atlètic Lleida|trans-title=Gabri García signs Marc Vales for Atlètic Lleida|newspaper=[[Bondia (newspaper)|Bondia]]|language=ca|date=20 August 2024|access-date=17 September 2025}}</ref> One year later, he joined [[Gibraltar Football League]] club [[Europa F.C.|Europa FC]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.andorraesportiu.com/marc-vales-inicia-una-nova-etapa-a-leuropa-de-gibraltar/|title=Marc Vales inicia una nova etapa a l’Europa de Gibraltar|trans-title=Marc Vales begins a new spell at Gibraltar's Europa|publisher=Andorra Esportiu|first=Víctor|last=Rodrigues|language=ca|date=4 August 2025|access-date=17 September 2025}}</ref> making his debut on 12 September in a 2–1 away win against [[F.C. Magpies|Magpies]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gibraltarfa.com/competitions/gibraltar-football-league-2025-3082381/match-report/fcb-magpies-1-europa-fc-2-3088009|title=Match Report: FCB Magpies 1–2 Europa FC|publisher=[[Gibraltar Football Association]]|date=12 September 2025|access-date=13 September 2025}}</ref>

==International career==
After representing [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] at youth level, Vales won his first [[Cap (sport)|cap]] with the full side on 26 March 2008 (one month shy of his 18th birthday), playing one minute in a 0–3 [[Exhibition game#International football|friendly]] home loss to [[Latvia national football team|Latvia]]. He went on to appear in more than 100 internationals.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/miscellaneous/ando-recintlp.html|title=Andorra – Record International Players|website=[[RSSSF]]|first1=Sébastien|last1=Duret|first2=Roberto|last2=Mamrud|access-date=15 February 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.marca.com/2012/10/11/futbol/equipos/real_madrid/1349952461.html|title=El internacional número 20|trans-title=International number 20|newspaper=Marca|first=Hugo|last=Cerezo|language=es|date=11 October 2012|access-date=15 February 2016}}</ref>

Vales scored his first goal on 11 October 2019, as the hosts defeated ten-man [[Moldova national football team|Moldova]] 1–0 in the [[UEFA Euro 2020]] [[UEFA Euro 2020 qualifying|qualifiers]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://as.com/futbol/2019/10/11/eurocopa/1570830840_258006.html|title=Andorra gana el primer partido de clasificación de su historia|trans-title=Andorra win the first qualifier in their history|newspaper=[[Diario AS]]|first=Fernando|last=Sánchez Tavero|language=es|date=11 October 2019|access-date=12 October 2019}}</ref> On 2 September 2021, he netted twice in a 2–0 home win over [[San Marino national football team|San Marino]] in the [[2022 FIFA World Cup]] [[2022 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)|qualifying stage]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.faf.ad/pnfg/NNws_ShwNewDup?codigo=1008266&cod_primaria=3000301&cod_secundaria=3000301|title=Victòria! Andorra és superior a San Marino i venç amb un doblet de Marc Vales|trans-title=Victory! Andorra best San Marino and win with a Marc Vales brace|publisher=Andorran Football Federation|language=ca|date=2 September 2021|access-date=11 July 2025}}</ref>

Vales made his 100th appearance for the country on 10 June 2025, in the 3–0 away loss against [[Serbia national football team|Serbia]] in a [[2026 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)|2026 World Cup qualifier]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/esports/250612/marc-vales-fa-100-partits-amb-seleccio-i-lamenta-derrota-serbia_174803.html|title=Marc Vales fa 100 partits amb la selecció i lamenta la derrota a Sèrbia|trans-title=Marc Vales reaches 100 games with the national team and regrets loss in Serbia|newspaper=Diari d'Andorra|first=Ivan|last=Álvarez|language=ca|date=12 June 2025|access-date=11 July 2025}}</ref>
